about: The outline of a life as the Journal tells it (words composer, unit 6; docs/design/words-composer.md, part 3: 'A Journal paragraph and a news story have one'). Read by the one telling planner in src/director/journal.ts. The past is told in a few short paragraphs, one per stretch kind, in this order; what the player did in play is told after it, one paragraph per event or per race, in more detail. A record goes to the first paragraph whose `kinds` prefix its cause kind (or whose `beat` it carries), else to `family`. `young: true` takes every record from before the person came of voting age. A paragraph's sentences are the bank's (data/english/parts/journal.json); this file holds no sentence. A year in which nothing on record changed has no sentence: every sentence is a record.

workWords.about: The kind of work an employer's record says it does (the last part of its classification, the same kinds the business names are drawn for: src/core2/data/business/names.json), as a person says what they worked in. A kind not here is not said; the run is then told by its place.

workJoin.about: How the folded working life's pieces join into one sentence: the run, then how it went, then where it ended.

merge.about: What laws the person learned were behind what they pay did to them, told by the bill that moved and about how much a month (the price engine's own record: the rule's good and the moved amount), several on one day as one sentence.

goodBills.about: The bill a price rule's good shows up on, as a person says it (src/core2/data/prices/goods.json keys).

leanWords.about: Which way a view moved, by the sign of the views engine's lean change (-2 very liberal to +2 very conservative).

stretches.about: The past is told in stretches of life (lead, Nov 13): growing up, then each place lived. A stretch longer than breakYears with more than breakRecords records may break once, at its first child, else its partnership. Words judgment, read against the Journals of drawn 36-year-olds.
